label: DiskStation DS220+ 2-bay NAS
description: 2-bay desktop NAS with two 1GbE RJ45 ports that support link aggregation and failover. There is no PCIe slot and no management port - both NICs are data ports.
notes: Onboard: 2x 1GbE RJ45, no expansion slot at all (10GbE impossible). Both ports are data-plane; there is no separate BMC/OOB port. Link aggregation (802.3ad) and failover are supported.
